name: Semrush
tagline: A marketing platform for SEO, content and advertising that also tracks your brand's visibility in AI search.
about: Semrush covers keyword research, competitor analysis, site audits and content tools, and reports how a brand appears in AI-generated answers.
pros: Keyword, competitor and backlink research in one place.
Tracks how your brand appears in AI search answers.
cons: Paid plans are expensive for small sites.
The large toolset takes time to learn.
